title: Do explicit date-window rules improve accuracy across 12B, 26B, and 31B Gemma models?
summary: Twelve date-sensitive HIV and TB chart questions tested across seven setups — comparing Google Gemma 4 12B (8-bit), Gemma 4 26B Mixture-of-Experts (4-bit), Gemma 4 31B (4-bit), and two multi-agent teams with and without explicit date-window prompt instructions alongside our automated temporal warning check.
takeaway: Explicit date-window instructions boosted both single-model tiers: Gemma 4 31B rose from 84.2 to 86.5/100 (zero unsafe answers) and Gemma 4 12B rose from 80.2 to 83.5/100, outperforming both the 26B Mixture-of-Experts model (77.3/100) and the multi-agent team setups (73.1/100; the oversized 31B/35B team timed out on most questions).

arms.wide-team-high-contract-warn: Large multi-agent team (Qwen 35B writer + Gemma 31B checker)
